title: Bosco celebrate U17 title
description: Bosco celebrated U17 Championship title. They beat Cibona 88-80 in the Final. Luka Krajnovic (192-SG-04, agency: PEPI SPORT) scored game-high 31 points to lead the winners. He was named the MVP after the game. Cibona led by six points at halftime 49-43. But Bosco went on a 45-31 second half run to snatch the win. Mihael Tomic (C-04, agency: PEPI SPORT) provided 17 points for the champions. Marko Vucic (200-F-04) answered with 28 points for Cibona.
